candidate_semantics: All original zero entries are unlabeled candidates, not confirmed negatives.
fold_aggregation: Compute every metric within each fold and report the ten-fold mean and sample SD per dataset.

metric_reference.use: Drug-centric ranking of held-out associations with unknown disease candidates and reporting of AUPR and mAP@10.

leakage_controls: Held-out positives are zeroed before association-induced similarities are computed.
Unlabeled candidates are selected only from original zeros.
The 1:1 set exactly reuses the formal submitted evaluation sample; 1:5, 1:10, and 1:50 are deterministic nested extensions.
Training positives are excluded from every evaluation candidate set.
